tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ngharmā tsa tur rat+na mā la nā ma/bod skad du/chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhe
༄༅/ /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ngharmā tsa tur rat+na mā la nā ma/bod skad du/chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhe

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ ngha rmā tsa tur rat+na mā la nā ma/ bod skad du/ chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin chos sku'i mkha' dbyings la/ / nges pa lnga ldan gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mdzad pa'i zer gyis gdul bya'i pad+mo 'dzum/ /bde gshegs nyi ma dad brgya'i gtsug gis mchod/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul rin chen dpag bsam shing*/ /ma lus srid zhi'i gdung skyob bsil grib der/ /dad ldan skye rgu rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul/ / rnam bzhi'i yon tan ljon tshogs bshad kyis nyon/ /gang zhig mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las//brgal 'dod rnams kyis thog mar bsam bya ba/ /thar pa'i chos de zhi bde bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /da res tshe 'dir yongs su 'bad par bya/ /rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba'i lus/ /dal 'byor gru bo thob dus ma 'bad na/ /srid pa'i mtsho las nam yang mi thar zhing*/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal mang ldan rgyun mi 'chad/ / skye shi'i chu bo pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*/ /na rga'i lbu phreng kun nas 'khrigs pa'i gnas/ /nyon mongs dus rlabs srid rtse'i mtha' khyab pa'i/ /mtsho chen mi bzad 'jigs su rnam par rtsen/ /gang zhig thos nas skye shi rgyun chad de/ /bde chen mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral ba/ /zhi ba'i chos mchog rin chen gru bzang gis/ /srid gsum nyon mongs chu gter brgal phyir 'bad/ /da res thar lam byang chub ma bsgrubs na/ /phyi nas bde 'gro'i ming yang mi grags shing*//ngan song mtha' med gcig nas gcig brgyud de/ /gtan du 'khor ba'i gnas las thar thabs med/ /de bas blo dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams/ /dal dang 'byor ba'i mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas phan bde bsgrub par bya//des ni rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /dal 'byor thob kyang yid brtan 'ga' med de/ /thams cad mi brtan 'gyur zhing snying po med/

/skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /myur du 'chi zhes snying nas bsam par bya/ / 'di ltar snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyang*/ /me bdun chu gcig rlung gis 'thor ba'i tshe/ /skra rtse'i lhag ma tsam yang yong med par/ /thams cad stong ste nam mkha' gcig tu 'gyur/ /bcud rnams mi rtag 'gro ba g.yo ba ste/ /lha dang lha min mi dang dud 'gro dang*/ /yi dwags dmyal ba'i sems can ji snyed kyang*//dus mthar 'chi 'pho skye ba'i chu bor bying*/ /lo dang zla ba zhag dang dus tshigs dang*/ /skad cig mi rtag 'jig cing g.yo ba ste/ /dus bzhi 'gyur bas rnam par skyo ba can/ / rang gi tshe yang mi rtag 'gyur ba soms/ /yid brtan med do lus srog 'bral du nye/ /sang dang bdag gi tshe zad dus 'di gnyis/ /sngon la gang 'byung nges pa med do zhes/ /de ring nyid nas nges par bsam par bya/ /'chi ba bas kyang skye ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs/ /gang du skyes kyang bde ba 'ga' med de/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin me yi 'obs lta bu/ /'di las da res thar thabs btsal bar bya/ /dmyal ba tsha grang yi dwags bkres dang skom/ /dud 'gro gcig za glen rmongs sdug bsngal te/ /mi rnams nyes gsum brgyad kyis yongs su gdung*/ /lha min 'thab rtsod lha rnams 'chi 'pho ltung*/ /bde sdug 'gyur zhing 'du byed sdug bsngal mang*/ /lha yul 'byor bde dag las tshe 'phos nas/ /slar yang dmyal ba'i me nang 'jug 'tshal bas/ /'di 'dra bsams nas srid las 'da' bar mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam sad ka 'dra/ /'gyur zhing mi rtag dor nas 'gro dgos pas/ /'khor dang longs spyod la sogs ci zhig bya/ /da lta nyid du chos la 'bad par bgyi/ /'dod pa dug dang mtshon dang me 'dra zhing*/ /yongs su gdungs bas bde ba'i go skabs med/ /bsags dang bsrung dang spel bas sdug bsngal zhing*/ /khengs dang 'jungs dang ser snas rtag tu 'ching*/ /kun dang rtsod bcas nyon mongs zag pa 'phel/

/'du 'dzis g.yeng zhing lus dang srog la rgol/ /don dang bya ba mang zhing chos dang 'gal/ /'phags pa rnams kyis rtag tu smad pa yin/ /'dod pa chung rnams ngang gis dge ba 'phel/ / des na zhi ba'i thar lam zhugs rnams kyis/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes ldan par mdzod/ / 'dod pa zad na 'phags pa dngos yin la/ /'dod pa chung na 'phags pa'i rigs zhes bya/ /'dod ldan sdug bsngal nyon mongs 'phel ba ltar/ /'dod pa chung rnams ngang gis dge ba 'phel/ /de bas sngon gyi dam pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ / rtag tu chog shes yo byad bsnyung bar bya/ /mi dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa'ang tshad med de/ /don med rnam par g.yengs shing bya ba'ang mang*/ /khro dang 'thab rtsod 'phel zhing chags sdang skye/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal 'go zhing snying po med/ /ji ltar byas kyang mgu ba'i dus med la/ / gang ltar bstan kyang phan pa'i go skabs dka'/ /de ltar mnyan yang legs pa'i chos med la/ /bshes ltar mthun yang tha ma 'bral bar 'gyur/ /de bas 'khor dang mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun la/ / nye bar brten pa'i 'brel 'dris kun spangs te/ /gcig pur dben par dam chos sgrub pa'i phyir/ /de ring nyid nas nges par 'bad par bya/ /sngon gyi skye bo dam pa mchog rnams kyang*/ /dben par gnas las bdud rtsi brnyes zhes gsungs/ /de phyir bdag kyang zhi ba sgrub pa'i phyir/ /nags nang dben pa gcig pur gnas par bya/ /dben pa'i gnas ni rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags/ /mi srun mi med zab mo'i ting 'dzin 'phel/ /ngang gis chos 'grub mi rtag skyo shas skye/ /yo byad skyungs shing 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng med/ /dad dang nges 'byung yon tan tshogs mang zhing*/ /'brel 'dris med pas ngang gis bya ba nyung*/ /gzhan gyi sems 'dzin ngo srung brgyad med/ /rang dbang 'byor bde nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da'/ /dal 'byor don yod sgrub pa snying por byed/ /de sogs yon tan brjod kyis mi lang bas/

/gcig pur rab tu dben pa'i nags khrod du/ /tshe gang zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar legs gsung chos kyi char bsil bas/ /nyon mongs gdung ba'i rtog pa rab zhi nas/ /ting 'dzin dge tshogs pad mtsho rab gang ste/ /zhi ba'i gnas na 'byor ba rab rgyas shog /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba las/ blo chos su 'gro ba'i rabs te dang po'o// //de ltar rab dkar dam pa'i chos mchog la/ /dad pas rab zhugs thar lam 'dod rnams kyis/ /rang gi sems nyid rab tu gdul bya'i phyir/ / chos de lam du 'gro ba rab tu gces/ /'di ltar rgyal ba'i bstan la rab zhugs nas/ / thos bsam sgom par chas pa de dag kyang*/ kha cig ma zhi rang rgyud ngan pa dang*/ / la la lam log dman dang lam gol zhugs/ /'dod sred che dang tshe 'dir g.yengs la sogs/ /chos dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa de dag kun/ /chos de lam du ma song dag las byung*/ /de las 'di phyi'i nyes pa tshad med de/ /'khrul pas bslus gang 'chi khar 'gyod pa nyid/ /bar dor 'jigs dngangs phyi ma ngan song 'gro/ /gtan du srid las thar pa'i skabs med do/ /de bas chos de lam du 'gro bar bya/ /ji ltar nad kyi gnyen por mi dag gis/ /bkru sman sbyar yang de nyid ma dag na/ /yongs su gdung bas slar la gdungs pa bzhin/ /gnyen por ma song chos la dgos pa ci/ /'di na de 'dra'i nyes pa tshad med pas/ /dad ldan skye bos legs par shes par bya/ /de la chos de lam du 'gro ba ni/ /thog mar dge ba'i bshes la rag las pas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam par bsten pa gces/ /de las legs rgu'i yon tan du ma 'byung*/ /de yang thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ / zhi zhing dul ba bzod dang ldan pa ste/ /sdom dang dam tshig spyod tshul phun sum tshogs/ /mang du thos shing legs par sbyangs pa che/ /byin rlabs tshad med gzhan snang ngang gis 'gyur/ /tshe 'di ma 'dres chos brgyad mkha' ltar dag /'brel tshad don ldan thar lam 'god pa 'di/

/snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul te/ /rab dang gus pa chen pos bsten par bya/ /de las phan yon tshad med zad med de/ /srid la skyo zhing nges 'byung blo sna thung*/ /tshe 'di blos thengs 'khrul snang bdag 'dzin 'jig /ngang gis dul zhing thos bsam sgom pa ldan/ /dad sogs rgya che sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /tshe 'di don yod phyi ma 'bras dang bcas/ /de phyir dam pa rnams la bsten par bya/ /de yang rang gi sgo gsum zol med pas/ /nad pas sman pa tshong pas ded dpon dang*/ /gru pas mnyen pa mgron pos skyel ma ltar/ /gus pa'i sri zhus rtag tu mnyes par bya/ /ma dad log par lta ba'i sems skyes na/ /skad cig grangs bzhin ngan 'gror 'jug par gsungs/ /de bas bshags sdom 'gyod tshangs chen po yis/ /dam tshig rnam dag mig bzhin bsrung la 'bad/ /de ltar bshes gnyen dam par rab bsten nas/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud sbyangs byas nas/ /thar pa kho na 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis/ /gang byed dge ba 'dun pas bsgyur ba ni/ /chos de lam du 'gro ba'i man ngag yin/ /nyan dang sems dang kha ton byed na'ang*/ /rang rgyud thar pa'i don du de brtsam zhing*/ /'bri dang klog dang 'dzin dang 'chad pa na'ang*/ /thar pa kho na 'dod pas brtsam par bya/ /sgom dang lta dang spyod par byed pa na'ang*/ /thar pa kho na'i sems dang ma bral bas/ /nges 'byung skyo shas drag pos 'bad par bya/ /snying po'i man ngag 'di las gong na med/ /za nyal 'gro 'dug smra brjod bsam la sogs/ /mdor na bya ba gang dang gang byed kyang*/ /thar pa 'dod pa'i blo dang ma bral bas/ /skyo shas bskyed de sems rgyud gdul bar bya/ /'di ni dam chos lam du 'gro ba'i gnad/ /khyad par theg chen lam du 'gro byed pa/ / dge ba gang byed gzhan don dmigs pa ste/ /snying rjes sems bskyed mos bsngo yi rang zhing*/ /sems can don phyir yongs su bsgrub pa'o/ /'di ltar 'gro kun bdag gi pha dang ma/

/gnyen dang rtsa lag phan gdags zhing yin la/ /bdag kyang gzhan don byang chub sems bskyed pas/ /'gro ba'i don du dge ba bsgrub par bya/ /bdag gi dge bas 'gro ba bde bar 'gyur/ /de kun sdug bsngal bdag la smin pa dang*/ /bdag gi dge ba 'gro la smin gyur te/ /lus can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog /snyam du tshad med snying rje'i sems bskyed sbyangs/ /dge ba gang rnams sbyor ba sems bskyed dang*/ /dngos gzhi mi dmigs rjes la bsngo ba bya/ /de yang 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ni/ /sbyang bya sbyong byed yongs su sbyang ba po/ /sgyu 'dra med la snang tsam sprul pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin dag pas gzhan gyi don phyir bsngo/ /mos pa rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos rnams dang*/ /rgyal sras dam pa rnams dang bsod nams zhing*/ /ma lus kun la rab tu dad pa ste/ /rang don gnyis don gzhan don mos pa las/ /bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dpe med thob/ /yi rang rgyal dang de sras 'gro kun dang*/ /dge ba kun la dga' ba sgom pa ste/ /'di ni bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /tshad med chen por bsgyur ba'i thabs mchog yin/ /smon lam rnam dag 'gro ba'i don phyir gdab/ /spyod yul dag pa'i man ngag bsgom par bya/ /tha mal phyogs su skad cig ma yengs par/ /sgo gsum dge ba gzhan don snying por bya/ /rang rgyud btul nas lhag pa'i sems bskyed ldan/ /chos gang lam du 'gro zhes bya ba lags/ /de ltar don zab ngo mtshar rnga sgra'i dbyangs/ /zab cing rgya che'i nga ro snyan grags pa/ /ma rig gnyid myos 'gro kun rab sad de/ /zhi ba'i dga' ston rgya cher mthong bar shog /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba las/ chos lam du 'gro ba'i rabs te gnyis pa'o// //de nas lam gyi 'khrul ba sel ba yang*/ /thun mong khyad par bla na med pa las/ /dang po thun mong theg pa'i lam chen gang*/ /tshad med sems bskyed smon lam snying rje'i bdag

/rlabs chen spyod pas 'khrul pa sel ba ste/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po dang ldan zhing*/ /rang gzhan don gnyis kun tu sgrub pa na/ / chos khams dge ba 'dus ma byas pa yi/ /glo bur dri ma rab tu sbyangs pa'i phyir/ /tshogs dang sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam bzhi ru/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun bsgom zhing*/ /dag pa'i lta ba stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ / skyon med spyod pa pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /gang zag chos bdag gnyis po med rtogs nas/ /nyon mongs gnyen po'i thabs kyis sbyong ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam bzang ste/ /sgyu ma rmi lam 'khrul pa'i tshul tsam las/ /spang blang don byas dge sdig blang dor byed/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nyon mongs la/ /mi gtsang byams dang rten 'brel chu bos sbyong*/ / dam pa'i don du ma skyes rnam dag pas/ /'khor 'das gnyis med spros dang bral ba ste/ /bden pa gnyis don rten cing 'brel 'byung lam/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa chen po lags/ /khyad par lam chen gsang sngags phyi nang ste/ / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug thabs mchog dpag tu med/ /sna tshogs rim pas 'khrul pa sbyong ba ste/ /gsang sngags phyi gsum dag pa gtsor byed pas/ /spang blang res 'jog dri ma gnyen pos sel/ /nang ni zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes kyis/ /spang bya'i dngos de thabs kyis lam du bsgyur/ /bde gshegs snying po'i gzhi dbyings dkyil 'khor la/ /rang snang chos kun rang sems snang ba tsam/ /'khrul ba dngos med stong gzugs gsal snang nyid/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa/ /rigs lnga la sogs dag par dran byas te/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas snang srid dkyil 'khor gcig /lus lha ngag sngags dran rtog 'phro 'dur sbyor/ /tha mar 'khrul snang sangs rgyas zhing du blta/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas thams cad chos nyid dang*/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'od gsal dbyings la

'jug /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rlung sems las rung dbyings dang ye shes sbyor/ /zung 'jug dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ / 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa lags/ / bla med theg pa mchog gsang rdzogs pa che/ /lhun grub dbyings la dngos su sbyor ba ste/ /gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yon tan lhun grub nyi zla gza' skar bzhin/ / btsal ba med par ye nas lhun grub pas/ / 'bad cing rtsol med rang bzhin mngon sum lam/ /'od gsal dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'dus ma byas/ /rang gnas chos sku mnyam pa'i dgongs pa nyid/ /rtogs par byed pa gnas lugs lta ba'i mchog /dag pa'i dbyings la glo bur sgrib pa'i sprin/ /'gro sems 'khrul snang med bzhin snang ba yis/ /khams gsum rigs drug brgyud cing cir snang yang*/ /snang ba'i dus na don la grub pa med/ /mkha' dang sprin bzhin glo bur rkyen snang tsam/ / 'khor ba sgro btags mtshan nyid chad pa ste/ /med bzhin snang ste rang gi ngo bos stong*/ /stong snang dngos med rab rib skra shad dang*/ /rmi lam sgyu ma dung la ser 'dzin bzhin/ /ji ltar snang dus nyid nas grub ma myong*/ /gzhi med rten med thog ma dbus tha med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par shes par bya/ /'di ltar snang srid snod bcud chos rnams la/ /gzung ba'i yul med sprul pa mig yor bzhin/ /'dzin pa'i sems med bar snang dag pa 'dra/ / gzung 'dzin gnyis med 'khor ba yod ma myong*/ /med snang 'khrul pa rang bzhin shes pas grol/ /spang blang rgyu 'bras rkyen snang rang dag pas/ /

gnas lugs don la rgyu 'bras 'das shes bya/ /de yi rten gzhi rig pa byang chub sems/ /mya ngan 'das dbyings lhun grub chen po ni/ /don dam bden pa gdod nas dag pa ste/ /thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /rang bzhin 'od gsal zab zhi spros dang bral/ /ye nas rang gnas chos sku dri ma med/ / dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngo bor gnas/ /'di ni gzhi dbyings rdo rje snying po ste/ / gang gis de rtogs gnas lugs lta ba nyid/ /sgro skur zhi ba don gyi snying por rtogs/ /dri med sgom pa 'od gsal snying po ni/ /rtogs pa'i ngang nas bying rgod spros dang bral/ /yengs med blo bral yangs pa chen po ste/ / mkha' ltar rnam dag rgya chad phyogs lhung med/ /bsam brjod dmigs pa kun las 'das pa lags/ /spyod pa gang snang bden med dag pa ste/ /nang gi 'dzin pa gang shar rang grol dang*/ /phyi rol gzung ba rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul/ / don la gnyis med blang dor med par spyad/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs dgag sgrub chos rnams la/ / skyes pas rang grol rang bzhin shes pas grol/ /grol bas ye rdzogs chos sku mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /'khor ba spangs nas mya ngan 'das mi 'tshol/ /gang snang don gyi gsal 'debs me long la/ /gang shar shes pa rang grol chos sku'i rtsal/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin chos skur phyam gcig go /'di ni mthar thug don gyi dgongs pa ste/ /lta ba'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po lags/ /mdor na gang zhig ji ltar nyams len kyang*/ /bdag 'dzin rang grol nyon mongs dbyings su dag /thams cad thabs kyi spyod la mkhas pa ni/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa sel zhes bya bar bstan/ /de ltar chos tshul rin chen gru bo ches/ /ma lus skye rgu srid mtsho rab brgal nas/ /zhi ba rin chen thar pa'i gling mchog tu/ /zag med zhi bde'i dga' ston mthong par shog /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba las/ lam 'khrul pa sel pa'i rabs te gsum pa'o//

//de nas 'khrul pa ye shes dag pa yang*/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gyi rim pa las/ /dang po gnas skabs nyams len lam gyi dus/ /zab mo'i thabs kyis goms par byas pa las/ /nyon mongs gang skye dbyings su rnam par dag /rang gsal ye shes mngon du gyur pa ni/ /'khrul rtog ye shes dbyings su dag ces bya/ /de yang thun mong khyad par bla med la/ /bsten pa'i thabs kyis so sor dbye ba ni/ /gnyen pos sbyangs dang thabs kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ /rang sar rnam grol ma spangs dbyings su dag /gang dag 'dod la ji ltar bslab na yang*/ /'gag pa nyon mongs dag pa'i don du gcig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang*/ /phrag dog skyes pa'i rang sa ngos zin dus/ /rang bzhag rang grol ye shes rnam lngar dag /kun rtog me long chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes chen po ru/ /dug lnga'i 'khrul pa gnas skabs dag ces bya/ /mthar thug khams kyi glo bur dri bral te/ /byang chub zhi ba rdul bral brnyes pa na/ /dbyings kyi rang bzhin ci 'dra mngon du gyur/ /sku gsum chos sku ro gcig ye shes brnyes/ /dag pa gnyis ldan dbyings kyi sku zhes bya/ /rgyal ba nyid las gzhan gyi yul min pa/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'i sku gsum nyid/ /ye shes dang bcas ngo bo nyid skus bsdus/ /rtag khyab 'dus ma byas shing 'pho 'gyur med/ /yid bzhin nor bu chos sku'i dbyings na bzhugs/ /de nyid ngang las ye shes phrin las sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku'i rol pa ni/ /sar gnas rnams dang 'gro gzhan snang ba yang*/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs gdul bya'i bsod nams mthu/ /tshogs don dag las de ltar snang ba las/ / srid pa ji srid phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /nor bu dpag bsam ljon shing re ba skong*/ /'di ni 'khrul pa ye shes dag ces bya/ /de ltar don zab snying po'i rta bdun gyis/ /yid mkha'i lam nas gdul bya'i 'jig rten du/

/tshig don rnam bkra'i 'od stong 'phro ba yis/ /'gro kun ma rig mun pa sangs bar shog /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba las/ 'khrul pa ye shes su dag pa'i rabs te bzhi pa'o// //tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i khang bzang nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'byor pas rab brgyan pa/ /rang gzhan don gnyis dga' ston 'gyed pa des/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don bzhin bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /tshe 'dir srid pa'i ri bo phyir bsnyil nas/ /byang chub zhi ba rdul bral mchog thob ste/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog /don gsal gangs ri rgya cher mdzes pa'i gnas/ /rab dkar yon tan phyogs kyi tha grur khyab/ /gsung rab rin chen snying po'i gnas 'tsher bas/ / dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ me tog sprin gyi skyed mos tshal gyi nang*/ kun tu bzang po'i khang bzang zla ba chu shel gyis 'tsher bar sbyar ba ste re zhig rdzogs so/ /phyogs dus kun tu bde chen gyi char bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin du 'bab pas bsam rgu'i re ba thams cad 'grub par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) chos bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba/ -PAGE 300--PAGE 311--PAGE 299-
